items.prompt:
Earth's plate movement is driven by
A) convection in the mantle
B) wind
C) ocean tides
D) sunlight

From the center out, Earth's layers are
A) inner core, outer core, mantle, crust
B) crust, mantle, core only
C) mantle, crust, core
D) crust only
items.answer: A) inner core, outer core, mantle, crust

steps: These are Earth's layers in order.

items.prompt:
Convection in the mantle is driven by
A) heat from inside Earth
B) moonlight
C) wind
D) rain

In convection, hot material ____ and cool material ____.
A) rises; sinks
B) sinks; rises
C) stays; stays
D) freezes; melts

steps: Hot rises, cool sinks in convection.

items.prompt:
The plates ride on top of the
A) mantle
B) sky
C) ocean only
D) inner core

Plates move slowly because
A) the mantle flows very slowly
B) they are very light
C) there is no heat
D) they are frozen
items.answer: A) the mantle flows very slowly

steps: Slow mantle flow means slow plates.

items.prompt:
Which best models what moves Earth's plates?
A) Heat drives mantle convection that drags the plates on top
B) Wind pushes the plates
C) The Moon pulls the plates
D) Plates do not move
items.answer: A) Heat drives mantle convection that drags the plates on top

steps: Heat to convection to plate movement.

items.prompt:
During mantle convection, what cycles?
A) Mantle matter rising and sinking
B) Only air
C) Only water
D) Nothing
items.answer: A) Mantle matter rising and sinking
